title: Ermittlungen nach Schussabgaben führen zur Festnahme eines Tatverdächtigen

extraction.summaryEn: Following an arrest in a case of shots fired in a dispute on Karl-Marx-Straße in March 2026, a 40-year-old suspect was taken into custody on 24 July 2026. An uninvolved 24-year-old was hit in the leg and injured.
